description: Election Commission - Declare that W. M. Dayarathna Banda as a Member of the Tumpane P/S
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government authority (Thumpane Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It deals with electoral procedures, candidate nominations, and the declaration of an elected member to fill a vacant council seat, which falls squarely under the Elections category (Type 7) for electoral processes and related matters.
